title: Placement recovery after the 2023 hiring slowdown
summary: Placement closed at 71.80% against an 80% target. Core branches drove the gap; circuit branches held. The Council approved a recruiter outreach drive and deferred the package target.
decisions: Approved INR 12 lakh recruiter outreach budget
Deferred the average-package target by one year
outcome: Placement rose to 73.50% the following year — short of target but the trend reversed. The wider recruiter pool brought in lower-paying offers, and average package began to slide.

title: Research output against the NIRF submission
summary: Publications per faculty stood at 1.05 against a 1.50 target and citations per faculty at 6.40. The Council approved a seed-grant scheme and asked for a per-department breakdown each quarter.
decisions: Approved a seed-grant scheme for research-active faculty
Made department-level drill-down mandatory for research KPIs
outcome: Publications rose to 1.12; the reporting change stuck and is now standing practice.

title: Budget utilisation and the unreconciled Q4 position
summary: Utilisation was reported at 88.10% but Q4 was unreconciled at the time of review. The Council declined to act on a provisional figure and deferred the decision to the post-audit cycle.
decisions: Deferred all budget reallocation until the books closed
Required provisional figures to be labelled on the face of the brief
outcome: Final utilisation came in at 86.90% — 1.2 points below the provisional figure, vindicating the deferral.

title: Pass percentage and the rounding dispute
summary: Pass percentage was circulated as '92%' when the unrounded figure was 91.60%, which is below the 92.00% target. The Council directed that KPI figures be reported unrounded.
decisions: Directed that all KPI figures be reported unrounded
Ordered remedial coaching in the two weakest departments
outcome: The reporting rule is now enforced by the KPI engine itself.

title: Executive decision brief — 2025-26
summary: 9 of 9 KPIs off target; placement improving but average package declining for the first time.
decisions: Noted the average-package decline against the 2023-24 recruiter-outreach decision.
